asr.full_text: Seven legit ways to make money online. I think when it comes to making money online,. Most people, they make it so complicated, right? They make it, there's so many steps. And so many business models and so many even strategies. And different tactics. Today I'm gonna give you some clarity. So seven legit ways to make money online,. Way number one, and that is e-commerce. E-commerce, I'm referring to selling,. Let's say on Amazon, Shopify, right? You're selling a physical product. Maybe you get it from China, you get it from Alibaba,. Or even when you're selling products on eBay, right? That's like e-commerce business model. It's one of the most profitable business models online. However, it also is the one that requires you. The most amount of capital and experience. Now you're dealing with customer service, right? You're building a team, you're fulfilling the product. You are dealing with the image, the photo,. You're driving traffic maybe through the search engine,. You're doing paid traffic,. You are trying to tweak your e-commerce site. So that you get more sales,. And then maybe you do some affiliate deal,. But your margins are usually not very, very high. Because you're selling a physical product,. A B2C model, business to consumer,. So what it means is you need to sell a lot of volume. In order to make any significant amount of money. Second legit way to make money online. And that is drop shipping. Now what if you don't have a product to sell? What if you don't have a lot of money,. A lot of capital to get started? Then what do you do? Well drop shipping is another model. There are a lot of people making. Decent amount of money with this model. Now with this model you're basically working. With a wholesaler or a distributor. Where they have other products. And they will do the fulfillment. What you do, you're actually acting as like a marketer. You're driving the traffic through social media,. Email marketing, your website,. You can set up like a virtual storefront. Where you take the order and then you send the order. To a wholesaler or a distributor,. They will ship it for you. Typically they would charge you money. And sometimes they charge you kind of like a handling fee,. Could be a $2, $3, or $5, and that's how you make money. Now, your margin is very thin. Because you're selling one item at a time. You have to be very careful knowing how much. You could spend to acquire each customer,. To drive traffic, how much you can spend. To acquire each visitor to your website. So your metrics, you have to know very, very well. Because this thing, you could spend a whole bunch of money. And if you don't make those sales,. You're the one that's taking the risk, right? The wholesaler, the distributor, there's no risk, right? They only fulfill a product when you make a sale. So as a marketer, as a dropshipping business model,. You're the one that's doing all the marketing,. You have to front end a lot of marketing costs,. And you only get paid after you make a sale. The third legit ways to make money online,. And that is affiliate marketing. I love the affiliate marketing model. That's actually how I made my first fortune on the internet,. My first bucket of gold. Now, what's beautiful about the affiliate marketing model. Is you're acting as a middle person, right? It doesn't require you to have your own product. You can choose a handful of good products there. That you believe in, and you don't have to deal. With the inventory, you don't have to deal. With the fulfillment. All you need to focus on is being a good middle person. To sell these products online. And you can test different traffic sources,. And you can pay traffic or free traffic,. Drive them to the affiliate offer,. And from there, that's it, right? When you measure and track the performance,. And then you'll be able to get a commission check. Every single month, even after all these years,. Until this day, for the work that I did two, three, five,. Eight years ago as an affiliate marketer,. I'm still getting paid, right? It still provides a nice stream of income for the work. That I did so many years ago. So I love the affiliate marketing model,. But there's one catch. In order to be a good affiliate marketer, guess what? You have to be a good marketer. You have to know what you're doing in terms of like. Doing online type marketing, right? You have to know what is it that you are working on. It is not an easy thing, but it is easier. Than other types of ways to make money online. Oh, I got a message here. Awesome. Gotta stay hydrated. Legit way to make money number four,. And that is SaaS, or software business. Now, software business is a huge business online. It is a model that is absolutely scalable. If you know what you're doing,. And you can see companies making millions of dollars,. Tens of millions of dollars,. Hundreds of millions of dollars. I'm talking about like Infusionsoft. It could be ActiveCampaign, it could be GoToMeeting, right? It could be even hosting, tracking software. It's software that solves a problem in the marketplace. Now, this model, why is it so powerful? It's because it doesn't matter if you sell. That piece of software to one customer or 10,000 customers. It is the same product that gets replicated. That many, many, many users can use at the same time. And that's why it's such a powerful business model. And when it comes to technology now,. You can hire developers, you can hire programmers. To develop those software for you. Problem is, a software not done right,. You could burn hundreds of thousands of dollars,. Millions of dollars before getting a return,. But if you know what you're doing,. Software on the internet,. Absolutely one of the most powerful ways. To make millions of dollars online. Number five. Google AdSense. Now Google AdSense is an advertising program. That allows you to run ads on your website,. Or blog, or YouTube videos,. And you get paid when visitors click on them. The ads are generated from business. That use the Google AdWords account. Now, with Google, you need to have a lot of traffic. Maybe you can create some kind of blog,. Maybe it's through your YouTube channel,. But you need a lot of visitors. To make any significant amount of money. Now, the good thing is it's free to join, right? It doesn't cost you anything to join. But the downside is you need to create a lot of content. In order to create a decent amount of income. Or to maintain a good income. I have a friend of mine who used to make a ton of money. With Google AdSense. At his heyday, he was making over a million dollars a year. With just AdSense. And now guess how much his blogs make him? Less than $30,000 a year. So, it's one way to make money,. But it's not as good as it used to be. Legit way to make money online number six,. And that is what I call the expert business. Now we're talking about packaging your expertise,. Your skills, your knowledge, your passion. Into some kind of a product. I'm talking about online courses,. I'm talking about training programs,. I'm also talking about services that you could provide. Maybe you are a digital marketer,. You are running a social media agency,. You are doing any types of programs. That enhance people's business, enhance people's lives. That's what I call the expert business. Number seven, the last legit way to make money online,. And that is through YouTube. Now with YouTube, you think about,. YouTube could put everything together for you. Let's say you have an e-commerce business. You could create demonstration videos. And upload them to YouTube,. And in the description you can drive all that traffic. Back to your e-commerce site. You can do also tutorials teaching people. How to use your products on YouTube as well. Or if you're in a dropshipping business,. It is the same thing. You can have various keywords,. Different types of videos on YouTube. That people are searching for right now. And they watch the video, they like the product,. And then click the link and they could go to your website,. Your virtual storefront and buy from you. And then when you get an order,. You can send that to your wholesaler. And they can fulfill the order for you as well. And remember, we also talk about. The affiliate marketing business. Now, because the affiliate marketing business. Is so competitive, it's not just you as an affiliate. Promoting that particular offer, that particular product. One of the ways you can make yourself stand out,. Instead of just driving traffic to that offer directly,. In between, you can drive them to your email list, right? Where you are educating, informing your potential buyers. Through YouTube, through videos, through content,. Building their trust. And then once they want to learn more about it,. They click on a link and then they could buy. Your affiliate offer as well. AdSense, you can combine that obviously with YouTube. Because Google owns YouTube. YouTube is using the Google AdSense platform,. The expert business. Software, if you want to reach a mass market. Very, very quickly, you can easily run ads on YouTube. And giving away maybe a free trial,. The freemium model for your software. And from YouTube, you can see it,. You can reach millions and millions of people. Just like that. And from there, you can get a lot of users. Even you wanna test out the product,. You wanna see how people like your software,. That's one way to do that. And that's why I think YouTube,. If you have a strong YouTube channel,. You can combine all these ways of making money. Into this one thing. If you have a strong YouTube channel,. It will enhances any of these revenue streams. That you have right now. If you want to know how I grew my YouTube channel. From zero to over a million subscribers in record time. Without spending a dime on advertising,. Click the link here and get yourself registered. For my free masterclass. I'm gonna take you behind the scenes. And share with you my personal story,. How I became a YouTuber, kind of by accident,. And how I have made over a million dollars. Directly from YouTube. If you wanna know how I do that,. Click the link here or somewhere here,. And I'll see you in class.
